# antigravity-priority v1.3.8

## 更新内容 / Release Notes

### 中文

**v1.3.8 新增 Pro Argon 周额度预热，增强 Prompt Guard 的请求形态识别能力，并完善诊断与预览界面。**

#### 🔥 Pro Argon 周额度预热
- 配置中心可单独开启 Pro 凭证的 Argon 周额度预热（默认关闭），以最近一次探测到的独立 Argon 周额度为准；四舍五入显示为 100% 不视为满额，发送前不再额外查询上游。
- 手动全量探测与自动调度会预热本轮所有符合条件的凭证，单凭证探测只处理所选凭证；单个凭证失败不影响批次中的其余凭证。
- 后台重置扫描与 Gemini、Claude 5h 预热共用错峰车道，每个时段最多预热一个凭证的一个配额池；预热成功后该凭证七天内不再重复预热 Argon。
- 预热生成在调度锁外执行，并在插件关闭、热替换等生命周期过渡时排空活动队列，避免阻塞调度与残留后台任务。

#### 🛡️ Prompt Guard 请求形态增强
- 拦截改写不再假定上游格式，改为自动识别请求体（OpenAI、Claude / Anthropic、OpenAI Responses、Gemini / Antigravity、Interactions），兼容 CPA 传入的翻译前客户端载荷。
- 系统提示支持纯字符串、文本对象与字符串数组等多种入口形态，减少不同来源请求的漏改。
- Prompt Guard 规则输入框与搜索框禁用浏览器密码自动填充，避免误写规则。

#### 📊 诊断与配置界面
- 系统诊断新增提示词防护 KPI：启用状态、活跃/配置规则数、累计改写请求与命中次数、规则告警。
- 试运行预览改为逐条规则命中差异卡片（查找 → 替换、命中次数），输出结果使用只读文本框并支持一键复制。
- Argon 预热目标模型下拉统一为自定义选择组件；二分排查提示词补充 flash-lite 模型与 429 冷却刷新说明。

#### 📝 文档
- 中英文 README 概览进一步精简，补充 Pro Argon 周额度预热与诊断 KPI 说明。

#### ⚙️ 工程与测试
- 补充 Argon 预热候选筛选、队列排空、请求格式自动识别、系统提示形态转换、诊断 KPI 与预览界面的回归覆盖。
- 版本元数据同步至 v1.3.8。

### English

**v1.3.8 adds Pro Argon weekly quota warm-up, strengthens Prompt Guard request-shape detection, and refines the diagnostics and preview UI.**

#### 🔥 Pro Argon Weekly Warm-Up
- The Config Center can independently opt in to Argon weekly warm-up for Pro credentials (off by default). Eligibility uses the latest probed independent Argon weekly quota; a value that rounds to 100% is not treated as exhausted, and no extra upstream query is made before sending.
- Manual full probes and automatic scheduling warm every eligible credential in the round, while a single-credential probe only handles the selected credential; one credential's failure does not affect the rest of the batch.
- Background reset scans share staggered slots with Gemini and Claude 5h warm-ups, warming at most one pool of one credential per slot; after a successful warm-up the credential skips Argon warm-ups for seven days.
- Warm-up generation runs outside the scheduling lock and drains active jobs during lifecycle transitions such as shutdown and hot replacement, avoiding scheduling stalls and leftover background work.

#### 🛡️ Prompt Guard Request Shapes
- Interception now auto-detects the request body format (OpenAI, Claude / Anthropic, OpenAI Responses, Gemini / Antigravity, Interactions) instead of assuming the upstream format, handling CPA's pre-translation client payloads.
- System prompts support plain strings, text objects, and string arrays across entry shapes, reducing missed rewrites for different sources.
- Prompt Guard rule inputs and the search box disable browser password autofill to prevent accidental rule edits.

#### 📊 Diagnostics and Configuration UI
- System Diagnostics adds a Prompt Guard KPI: enablement, active/configured rule counts, cumulative rewritten requests and hits, and rule warnings.
- The dry-run preview now shows per-rule diff cards (find → replace with hit counts) and a read-only output textarea with one-click copy.
- The Argon warm-up target model dropdown now uses the shared custom select component; the bisect prompt documents the flash-lite model and 429 cooldown refresh.

#### 📝 Documentation
- Streamlines the Chinese and English README overviews and documents Pro Argon weekly warm-up and the new diagnostics KPI.

#### ⚙️ Engineering & Tests
- Adds regression coverage for Argon warm-up candidate selection, queue draining, request-format auto-detection, system-prompt shape conversion, the diagnostics KPI, and the preview UI.
- Version metadata synchronized to v1.3.8.
